units.source_text: 源氏公子看了二条院庭中的樱花，回想起当年花宴的情状，

en.t: Prince Genji looked at the cherry blossoms in the garden of Nijo-in and recalled the scene of the flower banquet from years before,

units.source_text: 自言自语地吟唱古歌中“今岁应开墨色花”之句。

en.t: then softly chanted to himself the line from an old poem: "This year the blossoms must open in the color of ink."

units.source_text: 深恐惹人议论，只得笼闭在佛堂中，天天背人偷泣。

en.t: Deeply afraid of stirring gossip, he had no choice but to shut himself away in the Buddhist chapel, weeping secretly every day where no one could see him.

units.source_text: 夕阳如火，山间树梢毕露。

en.t: The setting sun burned like fire, and every treetop in the mountains stood clearly exposed.

units.source_text: 而横亘在岭上的薄云，映成灰色。

en.t: The thin clouds stretching across the ridge were tinted gray in the light.

units.source_text: 际此百无聊赖之时，这灰色的薄云分外惹人哀思。

en.t: At such a time of utter listlessness, those gray thin clouds stirred an especially deep melancholy.
